final_decisions: PostgreSQL relational inventory is authoritative. Apache AGE v1.7/PG18 is the reference graph projection backend for v1.
GraphBackend is a port; optional Neo4j Community adapter may exist later without changing domain semantics or licensing the core under GPL.
Projection rows carry source entity version/checkpoint. A full graph rebuild must reproduce the same semantic edge-set hash.
Traversal is always bounded by max depth, max paths, max expanded vertices, wall-clock deadline and cancellation token.
Path ranking is deterministic: edge exposure weight + privilege gain + evidence confidence + target criticality; scoring formula is versioned.
Every relationship edge has provenance/source/confidence/observed_at. Conflicts are preserved and resolved by explicit precedence policy, never overwritten silently.
No write is accepted only into the graph projection. All imports land in authoritative inventory first.
